features.name: Brain
features.description: Processes your data in the background to connect information, keep knowledge up to date, and surface useful insights. Chat and Tell Omnesis work independently.

features.name: Tasks
features.description: Keep a personal task journal. Add, schedule, and complete tasks yourself or ask Omnesis to help. Enable the Brain as well for background suggestions and updates.

features.name: Watches
features.description: Watch for changes in your data and receive a notification when your conditions are met. Watches run independently of the Brain.
